meta.name: Amber Girls School
meta.description:
Ojaswini, a 15-year-old, sincere, sanskaari student of 9th grade chases her dream to be the Head Girl of Amber Girls School with focus and passion. This puts her ambition in direct conflict with her desire to explore all things ‘teenage’ and 'grown up' while dealing with the financial crisis her family is going through. Will she pursue her Head Girl dream or find her voice through this journey?

Rated A · Returning Series · First aired 1 May 2024 · India · Language: Hindi
Studio: Reliance Entertainment · Network: Amazon miniTV

Complete series. On your server: S1 9/9 | S2 9/9

On your server — Audio: Hindi

videos.title: Adam, Ojas And The Garden Of Amber
videos.overview: In Chandigarh 2008, 15-year-old Ojaswini, a student of Class IX, tries to strike a balance between being a goody-two-shoes, her crush Shaurya, and deciding what she actually wants to be- the Head Girl of Amber Girls School.

videos.title: Mata Ojas
videos.overview: Ojas finally makes a move on Shaurya, but she has no idea how to flirt. At the local jagraata, she becomes a joke in front of the Bolero Boy.

videos.title: Kiss-Matt
videos.overview: Ojas has a really bad day at school, and something really unexpected happens with her rival Ana, which shocks everyone.

videos.title: One Step Ahead, Two Back
videos.overview: Ojas deals with the aftermath of her kiss with Ana, and tries to cope with her relationship with her family going downhill.

videos.title: Thank You, Global Warming!
videos.overview: The students from Amber Girls School, Good Samaritan, and Ruby Hearts participate in a rally to raise awareness about global warming. During the rally, Ojas and Shaurya finally talk to each other. Later that night, Oja's plans to contact Adam take a turn for the worse.

videos.title: Adam And Leave
videos.overview: Ojas goes out on a date with Shaurya, but that turns out to be a major disaster.

videos.title: Oj's Day Out
videos.overview: Ojas and Ishtaar bunk a school day to go to the mall and spend time together, where she learns something about Tejas that shakes her to the core.

videos.title: Surprise Test
videos.overview: Ojas has a fallout with Ishtaar, and has to give a surprise test in the middle of her own crises. On her way home, she is creeped out by an incident that happens in the school bus.

videos.title: The Unsolicited Guests
videos.overview: Ojas deals with the aftermath of the bus incident, and tries to juggle her academic career and her personal life. Her pent-up frustrations lead her to do something that she would never dream of.

videos.title: Ganda Hai Par Dhandha Hai Ye
videos.overview: Ojas tries to save up to buy clothes for Tokhi's birthday party by starting a side business, but to no avail. Tejas' life turns upside down.

videos.title: A Secret Appointment
videos.overview: Ojas and Tejas go to the clinic to get an abortion, and Ojas gets caught for doing her side business.

videos.title: Ghar Ki Baat
videos.overview: Ojas and her family have a huge fight, leaving their relationship strained further.

videos.title: D for Danda
videos.overview: Ojas decides to get revenge on Insia for exposing her venture. Angad and Ojas confess their feelings online for the first time.

videos.title: The Day The World Ended
videos.overview: Ojas and her friends create chaos in the school on 'Donation Day' after hearing that the world would be coming to an end.

videos.title: The Secret Admirer
videos.overview: Ojas and her friends face consequences for the actions of the previous day, and finds out who her secret admirer truly is.

videos.title: Kyunki Dish Bhi Kabhi Cable Tha
videos.overview: Ojas finally makes a move on Angad, and also stands up for herself and Ishtaar.

videos.title: Babbu Ban Gaya Gentleman
videos.overview: Ojas and her family meet Ashok's friend Jasmeet, and some long buried truths about the family's financial condition come out.

videos.title: Lion Ya Bakri?
videos.overview: On the day of the annual fundraiser, Ojas stands up to her biggest bully in school and realises that she is better off without being the Head Girl.
